A '''chainmail chestplate''' is a piece of [[chainmail armor]], crafted from 8 {{MCW|Chain|iron chains}}. Unlike in vanilla, chainmail can be crafted, and every piece carries Thorns III.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
It gives 6 armor (up from 5 in vanilla) and has 300 durability (vanilla: 240). A full set gives 15 armor, the same as iron.

=== Enchantments ===
Thorns III is an ordinary enchantment on the item: attackers take damage, at the cost of extra durability.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

It melts down into one iron ingot in a [[blast furnace]].
